Reason: The chest X-ray shows a small, hyperlucent left lung with ipsilateral mediastinal shift and dextrocardia (heart on the right), which are classic radiographic features of hypogenetic lung syndrome (scimitar syndrome variant). This congenital anomaly explains the history of recurrent infections and stridor, as well as the current presentation.
